name: G_C6_core_forms
statement: The core of programming in the IR: core_form cards (values, binding, functions, control, memory, records, closures, handlers, boundary, concurrency) whose every required type, form, op and statement the IR has (engines/compiler_goals.py). Every language is learned as a map into this core, not function by function (docs/GENERAL_COMPILER.md §2).
